articles.summary: Forza Horizon 6 is set to release for PS5 on January 26. Preorders are live now at all the usual retailers ( see it at Amazon ). This new installment brings the racing action to Japan, in the series’ largest map to date, with all sorts of biomes to explore, ranging from mountaintops to Tokyo…
body: If you want a physical version (pour one out for PS5 discs after 2028 ), or a digital copy of the standard edition, you can buy one above. It just comes with the base game and no extras. However, if you preorder the standard edition, you’ll be able to upgrade to the more expensive editions on the PlayStation Store when it comes out on January 26.

Forza Horizon 6 is the latest entry in Microsoft’s open-world racing series from Playground Games. It’s already available for Xbox Series X|S and PC, having released on May 18, 2026. It features over 550 real-life vehicles to collect and spec out. It takes place in Japan, where you can race in all sorts of biomes.

You can build a Valley Estate to buy homes and display your collection of vehicles. You can play solo or co-op or competitively across a campaign filled with all sorts of race types. There are Time Attack Circuits and Drag Meets and stunts to pull off.

In this new era for Microsoft, not all of the company’s first-party games are coming to PS5. Gears of War: E-Day, for instance, is solidly an Xbox exclusive. But thankfully for PS5 owners, Forza Horizon 6 is still heading to Sony’s platform.

articles.title: Haunted Chocolatier Is Still Missing, But This Freaky Tea Party Sim Could Scratch Your Itch
articles.summary: Haunted Chocolatier looks like it could be the perfect, candy-bar blend of sweet and creepy once it launches--but developer ConcernedApe doesn't know when that might be.
body: Sundew studios writer and designer Allie Ast shows off the "cozy gothic murder mystery" Tearoom of Terror in all its Edward Gorey detail during the stream, which was presented by the Dames 4 Games nonprofit.

Like Haunted Chocolatier, which will let you melt, swirl, and sell your own fancy chocolates, Tearoom of Terror involves brewing lovely lavender teas and doling out cheesy scones to strange customers, like a seemingly homicidal heiress and an opera singer of no renown. You'll go through the soothing motions of keeping your own Victorian tea parlor running as finely as white lace… but it won't be as lovely as it looks.

"You're also the primary suspect in your aunt's murder!" Ast cheerfully reveals. So Tearoom of Terror will also feature moments of deduction like the underrated The Séance of Blake Manor, except you have a stickier relationship with justice than that puzzle game's upright detective.

articles.title: Tim Burton Horror Lives In Weird Steam Adventure That Reminds Me Of The Creepiest 2010s Games
articles.summary: My 2012 belonged to Slender Man. I was easily terrified by creepy, early 2010s computer games like Slender: The Eight Pages, but I couldn't resist their special blend of unicorn blood and twee.
body: The teaser from indie developer Miss Self Destruct describes Hell Is Other People--named for the famous Jean-Paul Sartre quote about being trapped in other people's perceptions of you--as "a psychological horror about social anxiety."

Its little girl protagonist has onyx eyes and hair that goes nearly down to her fingertips, so she looks a bit overgrown, like she might have washed up on some riverbank. Otherwise, she seems normal, with a thin mattress to curl on top of every night like any other lonely child. But that's not what her mother thinks.

"See what I have to deal with?" Mother says as our little girl stares politely at a party tray of frosted cupcakes. Hell Is Other People's Steam description explains that you won't collect items in your inventory, but social skills, so the girl responds to her mother's snide comment with Guilt--but it isn't impactful. She becomes paranoid, making lines of dialogue seem to jumble and melt together as the girl explains, "When I feel bad, people become so hard to read."

articles.title: Epic Reportedly Pushing Devs to Use AI, Delays Secret Star Wars and Marvel Crossover Shooter
articles.summary: Epic Games has reportedly delayed its secret Star Wars and Marvel crossover shooter as it pushes its developers to shift to an "AI first" production model. Details on the yet-to-be-announced Disney video game were shared by Bloomberg today.
body: Epic developers attached to the project have reportedly been encouraged to use tools such as Anthropic's AI assistant, Claude, with humans expected to oversee that work. Bloomberg also obtained an internal message shared by one of the Star Wars/Marvel game's directors.
"No more hand-written code,” an excerpt from the message said. The same message is then said to have added that all art for the project would be "generated with full AI workflows."

The report continued, stating that Epic underestimated the time and resources necessary to develop the Star Wars and Marvel shooter. Progress has been slower than expected, leading to the delay. When and where it will launch is unclear.

"We’re embracing AI-accelerated development, led by Epic developers who are the visionaries and creative drivers for everything we do," Epic communications director Jake Jones told Bloomberg in a statement.

articles.title: Every Magic: The Gathering Set Confirmed for 2027, Including Marvel: Darkhold Destiny
articles.summary: Wizards of the Coast is scaling back to six Magic: The Gathering sets in 2027. Here is the full schedule, including Kamigawa, Zhalfir, and what we could expect from Universes Beyond
body: So much has been made of Universes Beyond, Magic: The Gathering’s crossovers with other IP, that many have dubbed the game “the Fortnite of card games”.

2026 saw seven sets in a single calendar year, which means that—at the time of writing—we’re closing in on November's release of Star Trek. In 2027, though, things are changing — not only is Wizards of the Coast cutting the number of sets down to six (with three Universes Within and three Universes Beyond), but we won’t get a back-to-back of Universes Beyond at all. Hooray!
Here’s all we know about Magic’s 2027 sets so far, and what to expect from them, including the recently revealed Marvel: Darkhold Destiny.

The first set of 2027 will debut in early February, and it’ll take us to Nauctis. This “Sunken Realm” is all about being under the waves, so you can expect some deep-sea humans alongside merfolk, homarids, and seals.

articles.title: Sorry, Street Fighter Movie, But Mondo Just Won The Poster Fight
articles.summary: The new Street Fighter movie hits theaters in just a few days, and if you're a fan of the Capcom series, you might be tempted to celebrate with some new poster art on your wall.
body: Designed by artist and painter Gian Galang, this Street Fighter 2 poster captures one of the most iconic moments of the fighting game franchise, highlighting the legendary rivalry between Ryu and Sagat.

"Street Fighter 2 was the first video game I ever owned, and it reinforced the bond between art and martial arts that I loved as a kid and has defined my career as an adult," Galang said. "I did my best to create an image worthy of the Street Fighter legacy, depicting the Shoryuken between Ryu and Sagat, exploding with lightning, splitting the composition in two."

For this poster, Galang created a unique, multi-layered composition, and Mondo has reprinted it as a nine-color screenprint on high-quality House White paper. The poster will go on sale starting October 16 at 9 AM PT, and it is priced at $90.

While you'd think Ken Masters is Ryu's ultimate rival, a storied history between the globe-trotting fighter and Sagat has been explored over the years in film, manga, and comic books. In the original Street Fighter lore, their first meeting resulted in Sagat receiving his iconic chest scar from Ryu's Shoryuken, which drove the Thai fighter to join Shadaloo so he could get his rematch.
points: The new Street Fighter movie hits theaters in just a few days, and if you're a fan of the Capcom series, you might be tempted to celebrate with some new poster art on your wall.

articles.title: Netflix Reveals New Look at Greta Gerwig's 2027 Fantasy Film
articles.summary: Barbie and Little Women director Greta Gerwig is tackling C.S. Lewis' Chronicles of Narnia saga for Netflix, with a 2027 release on streaming and in IMAX theaters. On Monday, Netflix released a new look at Gerwig's Narnia: The Magician's Nephew in the form of a striking poster.
body: Our latest look at Gerwig's adaptation follows glimpses of Aslan, the talking lion who will be voiced by Meryl Streep, and Daniel Craig's Andrew Ketterley, the magician referenced in the film's title.

Narnia: The Magician's Nephew was previously expected to arrive in 2026, but Netflix delayed the film back in May. The new Narnia movie will be released in IMAX and globally in movie theaters on Feb. 12, 2027, and will stream on Netflix on April 2, 2027. Early showings in IMAX will begin on Feb. 10, 2027.

The Magician’s Nephew is the sixth book Lewis released in The Chronicles of Narnia series. Published in 1955, it's a prequel that details how Aslan created the magical land of Narnia. The book chronicles the early days of Narnia's history and is set 1,000 years before The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe, Lewis' first and best-known Narnia book.

Narnia: The Magician’s Nephew stars Emma Mackey, Carey Mulligan, Kobna Holdbrook-Smith, Daniel Craig, and Meryl Streep, as well as newcomers David McKenna and Beatrice Campbell. Gerwig is directing and writing the film.

articles.title: Nintendo Says It Has No Plans To Ditch Physical Games Yet
articles.summary: Unlike Sony, which has decided to move toward a digital-only game marketplace starting in 2028, Nintendo is sticking to an "agnostic" approach for the Switch 2 console.
body: "Historically, we’ve been very agnostic," van Zyll said to YouTuber Coelho no Japão. "We go off what the consumer prefers, and take that into account very heavily. We also have a platform that was just launched. We're barely just over a year into NS2 (Nintendo Switch 2), and it's got both digital and also physical--that capability. There are no plans to ditch physical. We know how much the fans like it as well, so our position has been to be agnostic."

Like its predecessor, the Switch 2 lets you run games by using either foul-tasting physical cartridges or downloads from the Nintendo eShop onto the console. One big difference in this generation is the introduction of Game-Key Cards as a low-cost solution for developers, which act as authentication keys for games.

These will require you to both insert the cart and download the game to the Switch 2, but since the cartridges aren't tied to your account, you can still sell them off at a later date if you choose to. Some Switch 2 games--like first-party Nintendo games and the upcoming Stellar Blade: Complete Edition-- do contain the full game on the cartridge.
points: Unlike Sony, which has decided to move toward a digital-only game marketplace starting in 2028, Nintendo is sticking to an "agnostic" approach for the Switch 2 console.

articles.title: 'Avater: Seven Haven' Showrunners Officially Reinforce a Major Fan Theory
articles.summary: With Avatar: Seven Havens, franchise architects Michael Dante DiMartino and Bryan Konietzko and showrunners Sehaj Sethi and Ethan Spaulding have fundamentally upended what audiences expect from the world of bending.
body: The series follows Pavi (Saheli Khan), a young earthbender from the walled city of Ellora, and her long-lost twin sister, Nisha (Aishu Devan), both of whom discover they’re the next Avatar. In a world that increasingly sees that mantle as a destroyer rather than a savior, the sisters must flee human and spirit enemies alike while uncovering the truth about their origins. Along the way, they're joined by airbender guard Jae (Major Curda), guard captain Karthik (Akshay Khanna), and cat-monkey companions Geet and Ruhi, both voiced by franchise veteran Dee Bradley Baker.
Sehaj Sethi: “There’s a reason. I don't think we can say why yet.”

It’s not the most revealing of answers, but it leaves plenty of room for speculation, particularly given how often the franchise has tied its geography to the spiritual history of the Avatar world. Fans have come up with plenty of theories of their own, which Sethi and Spaulding couldn’t verify, for obvious reasons. They range from interesting to ridiculous, and offer perspectives on where the Seven Havens storyline might take the future of the bending world.

articles.title: Ben Affleck Names Justice League His Career ‘Low Point’
articles.summary: Before Robert Pattinson adorned the bat ears and cape in Matt Reeves ' The Batman, Ben Affleck was the caped crusader. He was supposed to direct, produce, co-write, and star in his own solo Batman movie before he ultimately stepped away, leading to Pattinson and Reeves starting the "Epic Crime…
body: In a new interview, Affleck explains why we'll likely never get another Batman performance from him and why the experience of filming Justice League was a "low point" in his acting career.

Production of Justice League was as difficult as film production gets, and Affleck called it "so, so negative" during an appearance on Josh Horowitz's Happy Sad Confused podcast. He was going through personal troubles at the time, like struggles with alcoholism and a divorce. The film's original director, Zack Snyder, also stepped away in May 2017 after his daughter died by suicide. Warner Bros. tapped Avengers director Joss Whedon to finish post-production on the film; Whedon also directed two months of reshoots.

"I really saw how not to make a movie like that when the studio is at odds with the filmmaker. You're really making a mistake," Affleck said, referring to tension between Warner Bros. and Snyder during production after Snyder's previous DC film, Batman v Superman, was poorly received by critics and audiences. "That was what really doomed that," Affleck said. He was "glad and gratified" that Snyder got to return to film in his own way with 2021's Zack Snyder's Justice League.
points: Before Robert Pattinson adorned the bat ears and cape in Matt Reeves ' The Batman, Ben Affleck was the caped crusader.

articles.title: Epic Games reportedly delays Star Wars and Marvel shooter, as the Fortnite maker embraces "AI-accelerated development"
articles.summary: Epic Games has reportedly turned to gen-AI to finish up development on a shooter that crosses over Star Wars and Marvel, which has been internally delayed.
body: That's according to a Bloomberg report from journalist Jason Schreier, citing anonymous sources familiar with the unannounced game. Epic's in-development project - a collaboration with Disney - is said to have hit a speed bump, and the Fortnite maker is apparently telling its developers to embrace more gen-AI tools for the rest of the game's production.

The new shooter purportedly features characters from both the Marvel and Star Wars series, and the company expected to have it out the door in March 2027. Now that the crossover project has slipped, Epic reportedly told its staff to adopt an "AI first" production pipeline and finish the game with tech such as Anthropic's Claude.

In an internal message seen by Bloomberg, one game director told developers there would be "no more hand-written code" and art work should be "generated with full AI workflows" - much to the surprise of many workers.

"We're embracing AI-accelerated development, led by Epic developers who are the visionaries and creative drivers for everything we do," Epic's communications director, Jake Jones, said in a statement to Bloomberg.

articles.title: No Man's Sky is somehow coming to mobile, and Hello Games says it's partly thanks to Light No Fire
articles.summary: Developer Hello Games has somehow managed to fit its universe-sized space sim No Man's Sky onto iPhone and iPad devices, and it's partly thanks to the studio's upcoming Light No Fire.
body: A decade after its hugely divisive launch and subsequent years-long comeback, No Man's Sky will come to IOS on the 28th of October with all of its numerous updates included. Hello Games promise the game will run on devices going as far back as the iPhone 11, and pre-orders open today.

"For nearly three years, we've had this little side project. There's something incredible about this universe fitting in your pocket," studio co-founder Sean Murray said in a deep dive video (below). "We want console quality visuals and gameplay that you can play anywhere. We support touch, we support controllers, even mouse and keyboard. This is something I've loved working on."

Murray also explained that Hello Games has made "tons of tweaks and improvements" that should benefit players on all platforms - PC, PlayStation, Switch and Xbox included. But once upon a time, the team thought a mobile port "would never be possible."
Of course, iPhones have become increasingly powerful in the decade since No Man's Sky first landed, though there's another reason why the port can even exist and run today: Light No Fire.

articles.title: Dragon Quest co-creator Yuji Horii releases new AI-generated game, and he says it took 30 minutes to make
articles.summary: Dragon Quest co-creator Yuji Horii has just released a new game that he says was made (or, rather, prompted) in about half an hour thanks to gen-AI.
body: In an online post from this weekend, the famed game developer recalled how he created 1983's The Portopia Serial Murder Case mostly on his lonesome. "I came up with the story myself, drew the pictures myself, did the programming myself, and created the game all by myself," Horii wrote on X.

"And now, by using AI, even if I can't draw pictures or program, I can just give instructions to the AI and create a decent game all by myself. It's truly astonishing. By the way, the production time for the game below was just about 30 minutes. Oh, and don't press the boost button," he adds, while linking to a text-based interrogation game.

As noted by VGC, Horii is also toying with the idea of an AI-powered chatbot for one of his future games, as well. He's currently involved with Dragon Quest 12: Beyond Dreams and a surprise sequel to The Portopia Serial Murder Case decades in the making.

Generative-AI and its uses in game development have been hugely controversial in recent years - with players, developers and video game actors worried about job security. Just this month, Google and Unity revealed a quite depressing AI-game-making tool, too.

videos.title: Biohazard Exclusive Teaser Trailer: Chandler Riggs' Resident Evil 7 Fan Film (2026)
videos.summary: Ethan Winters, while searching for his missing wife, finds himself trapped by the Baker family - a deadly, unstoppable family driven to violence under the influence of a mysterious infection.
body: BIOHAZARD is a short fan film based on the critically acclaimed video game Resident Evil 7, written, directed, and starring Chandler Riggs (The Walking Dead). The film reunites Riggs with Jason Douglas (The Walking Dead, Preacher, Dragon Ball), who portrays Jack Baker - the patriarch of this twisted family - alongside Mary Rachel Quinn (Outer Banks), Eugenie Bondurant (The Conjuring: The Devil Made Me Do It, The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 2), Johnathan O’Neil (The Pitt), and newcomer Sam Coyles.

BIOHAZARD began as a passion project driven by a desire to bring the isolated, intense, gripping story of Resident Evil 7 into live-action. The production team spent days transforming Arturo Fuente’s original cigar factory in Tampa Bay into a full-scale section of the Baker estate, creating a practical, immersive environment specifically for the production. The film combines practical production design, practical special effects, practical stunt work, and minimal VFX to recreate the intense, physical horror of the game, while paying homage to the films that inspired it.

videos.title: DF Direct Weekly #285: Dragon's Dogma 2 Switch 2, P.T Native PC Port, Galactic Racer PC Tested!
videos.summary: Thanks to Alienware for sponsoring DF Direct. To learn more about the Alienware AREA-51 Gaming Desktop, check out:
body: Dragon's Dogma 2 launched with problematic performance on current-gen consoles, making a Switch 2 port seemingly impossible. But the game improved and now the Switch 2 version is here and it's almost brilliant. The panel discuss the new port in depth, before moving on to their thoughts on the PC version of Star Wars: Galactic Racer. Then it's on to a remarkable native PC port of Hideo Kojima's P.T - complete with ray tracing! - before the show ends on a more sombre note with Sony selling off its VR patents to Meta. And presumably that means the end of PSVR.
